semiconductor_relevance: High — MINSEOA Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in polyimide materials essential for semiconductor and display applications.
summary: MINSEOA Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D, production, and sales of advanced polyimide materials used in semiconductor devices. Their products serve critical functions such as passivation and dielectric layers, catering to various applications including IC front-end and advanced packaging.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Zhangqiu District, Jinan City, Shandong Province, with R&D centers in Beijing and Shanghai.
